pr_title: Ignore renamed formulae when checking for unversioned formulae
pr_body:
- [x] Have you followed the guidelines in our [Contributing](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/HEAD/CONTRIBUTING.md) document?
- [x] Have you checked to ensure there aren't other open [Pull Requests](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/pulls) for the same change?
- [x] Have you added an explanation of what your changes do and why you'd like us to include them?
- [ ] Have you written new tests for your changes? [Here's an example](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/HEAD/Library/Homebrew/test/PATH_spec.rb).
- [x] Have you successfully run `brew style` with your changes locally?
- [x] Have you successfully run `brew typecheck` with your changes locally?
- [x] Have you successfully run `brew tests` with your changes locally?

-----
This fixes #13772.

There is an audit for versioned formulae that makes sure an unversioned formula of the same name exists already. This ignores that check when we explicitly removed the unversioned formula by checking if it was renamed first.

Also, there is no need to check for `formula.tap` because `formula.core_formula?` guarantees the presence of `formula.tap`.

comments:
It's interesting that the same error message gets spit out regardless of the `postgresql` version used in the audit.

```shell
$ brew audit postgresql@14
Warning: Use postgresql@14 instead of deprecated postgresql
$ brew audit postgresql@13
Warning: Use postgresql@14 instead of deprecated postgresql
$ brew audit postgresql@12
Warning: Use postgresql@14 instead of deprecated postgresql
$ brew audit postgresql@11
Warning: Use postgresql@14 instead of deprecated postgresql
$ brew audit postgresql@10
Warning: Use postgresql@14 instead of deprecated postgresql
$ brew audit postgresql@9.6
Warning: Use postgresql@14 instead of deprecated postgresql
$ brew audit postgresql@9.5
Warning: Use postgresql@14 instead of deprecated postgresql
$ brew audit postgresql@9.4
Warning: Use postgresql@14 instead of deprecated postgresql
```

Another interesting thing I found was that the audit messages for the old postgresql formulas for versions 9.4 and 9.5 seem to produce even more confusing messages.

```bash
$ brew audit postgresql94
Warning: Use postgresql@9.4 instead of deprecated postgresql94
Warning: Use postgresql@9.4 instead of deprecated postgresql94
Warning: Use postgresql@14 instead of deprecated postgresql
$ brew audit postgresql95
Warning: Use postgresql@9.5 instead of deprecated postgresql95
Warning: Use postgresql@9.5 instead of deprecated postgresql95
Warning: Use postgresql@14 instead of deprecated postgresql
```

I think the line you mentioned is part of the problem. The main thing seems to be that the list of renamed formula ([formula_renames.json](https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/blob/master/formula_renames.json) over on [Homebrew Core](https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core)) appears to only have one formula that could be misinterpreted for another after stripping the version number and that is postgresql. The warning is being thrown from `Formulary::Taploader.formula_name_path`.

What is happening here is that there is an attempt to check that each versioned formula has an unversioned alternative that is not working correctly.

The check occurs here in [`formula_auditor.rb`](https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/f765382cb6d312e3cdebd955a2601998390fe0b0/Library/Homebrew/formula_auditor.rb#L54-L70) and the offending line is the one mentioned by @xrisk above.

```ruby
          Formulary.factory(full_name.gsub(/@.*$/, "")).path
```

This line removes the versioned part of the formula name but `Formula#factory` adds it back because of the `formula_rename.json` file in `Homebrew/Core`. Otherwise you would get some errors.

```bash
~/Downloads ❯❯❯ brew audit postgresql@12                                     ✘ 1
postgresql@12:
  * postgresql@12 is versioned but no postgresql formula exists
Error: 1 problem in 1 formula detected
```

```bash
~/Downloads ❯❯❯ brew audit linux-headers@4.4                                 ✘ 1
linux-headers@4.4:
  * linux-headers@4.4 is versioned but no linux-headers formula exists
Error: 1 problem in 1 formula detected
```

The solution to this seems to be to ignore the lack of an unversioned formula if that happens after an explicit rename (for example `postgresql` was deprecated recently in favor of versioned formulae).

review_comments: Do we want to get rid of the `if formula.tap` check?

It's not functionally necessary because it's inside an if statement that requires `formula.core_formula?` to be true and that means that `formula.tap` must not be nil.

https://github.com/Homebrew/brew/blob/f765382cb6d312e3cdebd955a2601998390fe0b0/Library/Homebrew/formula.rb#L1943-L1947
Ah, of course. Sounds fine then!
